[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Janet was born about 1763 and died in 1793 in Glasgow; both years remain uncertain in the retained profile. A saved Findmypast derivative records Jannet Glasgow, aged 30, buried on 13 October 1793 at Ramshorn & Blackfriars, with consumption noted. The age-derived birth year is compatible but does not establish an exact birth, and the burial date is separate evidence rather than an exact death date. The earlier biography's 1763 and 1793 years remain approximate claims, not exact dates.
== Research Notes ==
An inspected Findmypast derivative transcript likely describes the same Jannet Glasgow burial already cited below: a person of that name, aged 30, was buried on 13 October 1793 at Ramshorn & Blackfriars, Glasgow, and the index records “consumption.”<ref name="FMP-093164">[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=GBPRS%2FGLASGOW%2FBUR%2F093164&tab=this Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Deaths & Burials 1564–2017'', Jannet Glasgow, burial 13 October 1793, Ramshorn & Blackfriars, Glasgow; inspected provider transcript, original image uninspected.]</ref> The indexed 1763 birth year is derived from age 30, and its death-date field gives only an uncertain 1793. This is a strong but qualified match to this Janet Glasgow profile; it adds a source URL for the burial account rather than independent evidence of an exact birth or death day. The profile’s uncertain 1763 birth and 1793 death fields remain unchanged pending inspection of the original entry.
